Your eleven projects 60.8 points. The transfer from Wood to Watkins nets 6.4 with no points hit — a clear gain that you have the free transfer to take.

Haaland carries a knock but is expected to play and has the armband. He is 0.3 clear of Salah, your next-best option, and sits on an 8.2 projection despite the 25% chance he scores 10 or more. The risk is real — there is an 8% chance he returns 2 or fewer — but the model prefers him. If you want to move the armband to Salah before the deadline, that choice is yours to make.

Your club structure is tight. Arsenal and Manchester City account for five of your outfield players combined. This concentration was built into the initial squad; it is not caused by the Watkins trade, which removes a Nottingham Forest player and adds a Aston Villa one.

Make the Wood–Watkins swap. You have no pressing reason to act elsewhere, and your bench offers nothing that forces a move.

Your eleven projects 60.8 points. Haaland is the captain at 8.2, a tight 0.3 ahead of Salah, though he carries a knock with a 75% chance of playing and only an 8% chance of scoring 2 or fewer — so you're betting on either fitness or a clean sheet's worth of points if he doesn't start.

The model recommends Wood to Watkins for a net gain of 6.4 points over the horizon, taking your only free transfer. This costs nothing in points hits. Watkins is the stronger projection in that slot going forward.

You have three Arsenal players in the eleven and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. The bench is thin, with Mykolenko at 3.1 being the only meaningful cover; Anderson and Muniz project 2.9 and 2.4 respectively. Pope sits second among keepers, so you have cover there if Raya doesn't play, though that's not flagged as a concern.

Making the transfer leaves you with £0.5m unspent and one free transfer banked for next week.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland captained. He carries risk — a quarter chance he doesn't play — but the model backs him anyway. Salah is only 0.3 points behind as captain, so there's little between them if Haaland's fitness worsens.

The model wants you to move Wood to Watkins for a net gain of 6.4 points, at no cost. You have one free transfer and £0.5m in the bank, so you can make it. Watkins projects higher across the horizon ahead.

Your outfield is 3-4-3 with three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. The bench is thin; your best cover is Mykolenko at 3.1.

You're set up well if Haaland plays. If he doesn't and you've captained him, you fall back on Salah's 7.9, which is solid but costs you the gap between them. Taking the transfer as offered gives you a cushion elsewhere.
